findings.title: Nonexistent local times during DST spring-forward are scheduled as if they existed
findings.evidence: The function constructs the target directly from the local date and wall time using the zone, without validating that the wall time actually exists on that date. On DST spring-forward days, some local times are skipped; this code will still build and return a UTC instant for that skipped wall time, so the job will not run at the requested daily wall time in the target zone.
findings.recommendation: After constructing the local candidate, validate that it round-trips through UTC back to the same local wall time and date in the target zone. If the wall time is nonexistent, choose and document a policy such as scheduling at the next valid local time or skipping to the following day, and add tests covering DST gap dates.
